positions.name: SuiteEnactsEnrollmentRuleThroughProbeArtifact
positions.frame: How does the e2e suite enact authority over reviewer-role allocation through its test assertion and the memory artifact instrumented to carry it?
positions.why: Both expressions perform an authority-ranking move: src-1 positions the suite as mandating that saving a memory enrolls its creator as reviewer, and src-2 subordinates the probe memory's entire purpose to carrying that rule. The conviction gradient (src-1 is decision-grade, src-2 is a supporting claim) is held in tension — the decision ratifies the rule, the claim instruments the artifact to transport it — but both cohere under the same directional read of system authority enacting role allocation through its own test artifacts.
